meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_1H_2411). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: CROSSOVER BLOCK CONFIRMED: 1F q18-q27 = 1H q1-q10, ten questions worth 40 marks. The per-question mark sequence matched before the papers were read, and reading confirmed it question by question. Coded in the same sitting as IGCSE-NOV24-F-P1; shared rows carry identical tags by construction.

GAP-CANDIDATE arithmetic_series_sum — q19, 5 marks. Sum of the first 30 terms and the sum of the 10th and 20th terms are given; the sum of the first 45 is wanted. Tagged simultaneous_equations as an INTERIM measure, the same handling as Jun25 1H q24. SECOND sighting.

GAP-CANDIDATE differentiation — q20, 4 marks, the equation of the tangent to a quartic at its minimum point. UNTAGGED: differentiating to locate the minimum is the whole question and no node covers any part of it. The final step (a tangent at a minimum is horizontal, so y = k) sits in understanding_straight_line_graphs territory, but tagging that for one mark of a calculus question would claim the wrong thing. topic set to algebra. SECOND sighting.

GAP-CANDIDATE set_notation — q4(a),(b),(c), 3 parts, shared from the Foundation paper via the crossover block (= NOV24 1F q21). Listing the members of sets given in notation, with no n(). Counted on the HIGHER slice here and on the Foundation slice there: profiles are sliced by board AND tier, so the same crossover question legitimately evidences the skill on both, which is how every other crossover item is already handled. Tagged venn_diagrams as an INTERIM measure — see the Foundation paper's note for why that tag mis-claims rather than under-claims.
q16 needs the area-of-a-triangle sine rule to recover the radius before the sector formula can be used; tagged sector_calculations first because the sector area is what is asked for.
q23 tagged solving_quadratic_equations_quadratic_equation first: the route is to set the curve equal to k and use the sum and difference of the two roots.
q11(b) tagged sketching_functions rather than plotting_straight_line_graphs — the curve has a reciprocal term and is not a straight line.
